issue_title: [Bug] Todo.from_dict accepts negative IDs without validation
approach: Add validation in Todo.from_dict to reject negative and zero IDs after int conversion. IDs must be positive integers (>= 1) to match storage.py next_id() behavior.
summary: Added validation to Todo.from_dict that raises ValueError when 'id' is less than 1. This aligns with the storage layer's next_id() which returns values starting from 1. Also fixed test_storage_atomicity.py which was using id=0 in worker processes.
